CLOSE EVIDENCE (resume session, 2026-08-22). Fix landed on main as 14aa285f963 (Gerrit change 2123, Change-Id I533bbe37cefa5a172faee2fb3d93673699ef0c56, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted via Rebase-If-Necessary).

Per-AC verification:
1. RCA: confirmed root cause recorded in the RCA comment (2026-08-22) — mechanism at file:line, 89-scan arithmetic match (23 pins + 22 stale x3 = 89; 89 x 5247 = 466,983 reduces), faulthandler stack oracle, caused_by cb6b-24b4-1056-4ee6 attributed with divergence note.
2. Scan-count regression test: RED re-proven in this session by reverting only the three src files to origin/main — 2 FAILED (test_pin_health_scan_count_constant_in_pin_count, test_compute_validity_scan_count_constant_in_pin_count), 1 passed; GREEN with the fix (3 passed in 59.3s).
3. Real-store timing re-run (instrumented, same load window): plan_review_health on epic 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a = 15.7s, full-store scans = 1 (was 745.2s / 89 scans; AC bound <=2 met); `rebar list --parent 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a` = 10.9s in the same window — show-side derivation is within ~1.5x of one list scan (AC bound ~10x). Verdict semantics unchanged: pin_status=stale-pin-drift, 23 targets, before and after.
4. Verdict preservation: tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py + test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py + test_plan_relation_snapshot.py = 37 passed unchanged. Local gates: make lint PASS, mypy 638 files clean, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0.
5. Enrich-drain overrun disposition: recorded in the RCA comment (write-path maybe_drain, O(1) gate marker cleared by every append under multi-writer load; the 20ms budget warning is by-design observability, not a cutoff); the contract decision is tracked in 6148-5d81-8e80-41e8 (discovered_from-linked, open). Not covered by change 2123 by design — it is a separate bounded mechanism, not the stall driver (never appeared in the stall stacks).

Close class: regression — cb6b (dcf41e78234) wired the gate-priced pin derivation into the default `rebar show` render; before it show never ran the derivation and could not stall.
